description: Look up one festival by name in a given year and return its computed date, lunar month, tithi and the rule behind it. Name matching is case-insensitive and partial (e.g. 'diwali', 'holi', 'makara'); first match wins. Use when the user asks when a specific festival is. Do NOT use to list several; use list_festivals.

name.description: Festival name or part of it, case-insensitive, e.g. "Diwali", "Holi", "Maha Shivaratri", "Onam", "Makara Sankranti".

name: festival_details

about.description: Short meaning and the lunar or solar rule that fixes the date.

date.description: Computed Gregorian date, YYYY-MM-DD (approximate, +/-1 day at tithi edges).

month.description: Amanta lunar month name in effect on that date, e.g. Ashwin.

name.description: Festival name, e.g. "Diwali / Lakshmi Puja" or "Makara Sankranti / Pongal".

tithi.description: Lunar day index at IST noon on that date, 0-29 (0 = Shukla Pratipada, 29 = Amavasya), as 'index N'.

title: Festival details
